title: "genin2 summary"
author: "Angela"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

## Objectives
* Merge all genin2 output TSVs and join to sample metadata
* Assess genotype assignment completeness by region and time
* Visualize primary genotypes across regions

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(gtools)

plot.theme <- theme(
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.background = element_rect("grey95"),
  axis.line        = element_line(colour = "black"),
  text             = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
  legend.text      = element_text(size = 8),
  axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
)
```

```{r paths}
f.in     <- "../output_genin2/"
f.met.in <- "../input_genin2/"

f.out <- paste0(Sys.Date(), "_summary/")
if (!dir.exists(f.out)) dir.create(f.out)
```

## Read and join genin2 outputs

```{r read-genin, message=FALSE}
gen.files <- list.files(f.in, pattern = "_output\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE) %>% mixedsort()
met.files <- list.files(f.met.in, pattern = "meta",        full.names = TRUE) %>% mixedsort()

gen.all <- map_dfr(gen.files, ~read_tsv(.x, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))) %>%
  rename(
    sample        = `Sample Name`,
    genin_geno    = Genotype,
    genin_subgeno = `Sub-genotype`,
    genin_PB2     = PB2,
    genin_PB1     = PB1,
    genin_PA      = PA,
    genin_NP      = NP,
    genin_NA      = `NA`,
    genin_M       = MP,
    genin_NS      = NS,
    genin_notes   = Notes
  )

cat(nrow(gen.all), "total samples\n")
cat(sum(gen.all$genin_geno == "[unassigned]"), "unassigned (",
    round(mean(gen.all$genin_geno == "[unassigned]") * 100, 1), "%)\n")
```

## Read metadata and join

```{r read-meta, message=FALSE}
met.all <- map_dfr(met.files, ~read_csv(.x, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))) %>%
  filter(segment == "HA") %>%
  mutate(
    collection_date = as.Date(collection_date),
    collection_year = as.integer(collection_year)
  )

stopifnot(all(met.all$sample %in% gen.all$sample))

met.gen <- met.all %>%
  left_join(gen.all, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(assigned = !is.na(genin_geno) & genin_geno != "[unassigned]")

region_ord <- c(
  "Western Europe", "Northern Europe", "Southern Europe", "Eastern Europe",
  "Western Africa", "Northern Africa", "Southern Africa",
  "Western Asia", "Central Asia", "Southern Asia", "South-Eastern Asia", "Eastern Asia",
  "North America", "Central America", "Caribbean", "South America",
  "Oceania", "Antarctica"
)
```

## Genotype frequency: all samples

```{r freq-all, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
geno_ord <- count(gen.all, genin_geno, sort = TRUE) %>% pull(genin_geno)

met.gen %>%
  mutate(genin_geno = factor(genin_geno, levels = geno_ord)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genin_geno, fill = genin_geno)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_bw() + plot.theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Genin2 genotype", y = "Count", title = "All H5Nx samples")
ggsave(paste0(f.out, "genin_genos_freq_all.png"), width = 7, height = 4)

met.gen %>%
  filter(assigned) %>%
  mutate(genin_geno = factor(genin_geno, levels = geno_ord)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genin_geno, fill = genin_geno)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_bw() + plot.theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Genin2 genotype", y = "Count", title = "Assigned genotypes only")
ggsave(paste0(f.out, "genin_genos_freq_assigned.png"), width = 7, height = 4)
```

## Assignment rate by region

```{r assign-region, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
reg_summary <- met.gen %>%
  filter(!is.na(region)) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total      = n(),
    n_assigned   = sum(assigned, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_assigned = mean(assigned, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_assigned))

reg_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(region, pct_assigned), y = pct_assigned, fill = pct_assigned)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct_assigned, 1), "%  (n=", n_total, ")")),
            hjust = -0.05, size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fee8c8", high = "#e34a33") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.4))) +
  theme_bw() + plot.theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% assigned genin2 genotype", title = "Genin2 genotype assignment rate by region")
ggsave(paste0(f.out, "assign_rate_by_region.png"), width = 7, height = 5)

reg_summary
```

## Assignment rate by region × year

```{r assign-reg-year, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
reg_year <- met.gen %>%
  filter(region %in% region_ord, collection_year >= 2015) %>%
  group_by(region, collection_year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total      = n(),
    pct_assigned = mean(assigned, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(region, collection_year, fill = list(n_total = 0, pct_assigned = NA)) %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = rev(region_ord)))

reg_year %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = collection_year, y = region, fill = pct_assigned)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_total), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fee8c8", high = "#e34a33", name = "% assigned",
                      limits = c(0, 100), na.value = "grey90") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2015, max(reg_year$collection_year, na.rm = TRUE), 1)) +
  theme_bw() + plot.theme +
  labs(x = "Year", y = NULL,
       title = "% genin2 genotype assignment")
ggsave(paste0(f.out, "assign_rate_reg_year_heatmap.png"), width = 9, height = 6)


reg_year %>%
  filter(collection_year>2019)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = collection_year, y = region, fill = pct_assigned)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_total), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fee8c8", high = "#e34a33", name = "% assigned",
                      limits = c(0, 100), na.value = "grey90") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2015, max(reg_year$collection_year, na.rm = TRUE), 1)) +
  theme_bw() + plot.theme +
  labs(x = "Year", y = NULL,
       title = "% genin2 genotype assignment")
ggsave(paste0(f.out, "assign_rate_reg_year_heatmap_since2020.png"), width = 5, height = 6)
```

## Top genotypes by region (assigned only)

```{r top-genos-region, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
top_n <- 10

top_genos <- met.gen %>%
  filter(assigned) %>%
  count(genin_geno, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
  pull(genin_geno)

met.gen %>%
  filter(assigned, genin_geno %in% top_genos, region %in% region_ord) %>%
  mutate(genin_geno = factor(genin_geno, levels = top_genos),
         region     = factor(region, levels = region_ord)) %>%
  count(region, genin_geno) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = region, y = pct, fill = genin_geno)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired", name = "Genin2 genotype") +
  theme_bw() + plot.theme +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of assigned samples",
       title = paste("Top", top_n, "genin2 genotypes by region"))
ggsave(paste0(f.out, "top_genos_by_region.png"), width = 10, height = 5)
```

## Summary table: assignment by region and year

```{r summary-table}
met.gen.year<-met.gen %>%
  filter(!is.na(region)) %>%
  group_by(region, collection_year) %>%
  summarise(
    n            = n(),
    pct_assigned = round(mean(assigned, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
    top_genotype = if (any(assigned, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      names(sort(table(genin_geno[assigned]), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    } else NA_character_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(region, collection_year)
```

## Write joined data

```{r write}
write.csv(met.gen, paste0(f.out, "summarized_genin_meta.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(met.gen.year, paste0(f.out, "summarized_genin_meta_year.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
